notes.title: Summer Sale Discount!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332051/8b4e6e84ac7afba0bd4a3d66d658130043a62e39.png[/img]

Play as the adoptive parent of a child born of war in this narrative game based on real history. Can you help Klaus/Karin cope with the heavy inheritance of the German occupation, so they will find their place in a country that is celebrating its freedom?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332051/11e5f6b1ae0020a7dd36f06309f6aa83a706f968.gif[/img]

You adopt a young Lebensborn child in Norway after WW2, but parenting will be hard as your child grows up in a hostile and hateful environment. See a different side of the war, inspired by the true stories of the Lebensborn children. Discover how hatred of our enemies continues to create victims, even after victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332051/02283a45c4e31b4b65b889ad2651e61c1aa24e75.png[/img]

We are hosting wonderful content creators to highlight topics of bullying, hatred, discrimination - and how all must be mitigated by empathy and kindness for change. Share this tragedy to change something for the future. You, can make a difference.

notes.title: Can you be the parent of a child that is hated by the society?

notes.title: Plushie Kickstarter
notes.content:
If you've ever wanted to spend even more time with your child in My Child Lebensborn, you will be very excited to know that Karin and Klaus plushies are coming soon! 

The kickstarter for plushies of your child will begin at 8pm tonight and run for 1 month. If we get 200 sales on each of the plushies it will be a success and we will begin sending them to you!

These limited editions will only be available now, so, if you are interested, sign up here: https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/my-child-lebensborn

notes.title: My Child Lebensborn Remaster Out Now!
notes.content:
We're so excited to announce that My Child Lebensborn Remastered is officially out for PC on Steam. We've been working so hard to make amazing new activities so that you can create more moments of happiness with your child in the face of tragedy. 

We're also so happy to bring achievements to My Child Lebensborn! How many can you get?
